r.name: P02 - Cossogno - Pizzo Pernice
r.description: From Cossogno amidst chestnut on the ancient cobbled mule track to Alpe Rugno, then for the meadows of high pastures and finally the long panoramic ridge that culminates at Pizzo Pernice

r.name: P12 - Pogallo - Bocchetta di Terza
r.description: From Val Pogallo to Val Cannobina, crossing the ridge where the Bove path runs. This was also the route of the partisans fleeing to Switzerland during the German-Fascist raid of 1944

r.name: P08 - Cicogna -Tregugno - la Soliva - Pian Cavallone
r.description: A challenging path for complexity, development and difficulty, the path from la Soliva to the Forcola Saddle is on steep meadows and You crosse a valley with vertical rocky walls supported by the chains

r.name: SENTIERO BOVE - 1A TAPPA da Cicogna a Pian Cavallone
r.description: Tough route for steep slopes to go up, but no technical difficulty, even marks, albeit sometimes distant, are present throughout the path and the trace is always visible

r.name: SENTIERO BOVE - 4A TAPPA da Bivacco Lidesh a Bivacco Scaredi
r.description: One of the most challenging stages of the Bove trail, the ascent to the Torrione on the Passo delle Crocette side is mountaineering and facilitated by chains, the ascent on the Bocchetta di Terza side is all on a trail with very exposed sections

r.name: SENTIERO BOVE - 3A TAPPA da Bivacco Alpe Forna' a Bivacco Lidesh
r.description: Panoramic ridge easy path but still very exposed trail. From altitude 1873 (Geo4Map), after Piota and before Cima Crocette, a possible escape route to the Pian di Boit bivouac is possible on easy meadows without trail

r.name: SENTIERO BOVE - 2A TAPPA Pian Cavallone - Monte Zeda - Bivacco Alpe Forna'
r.description: Panoramic path along the ridge that from Pian Cavallone leads first to Pizzo Marona, then to Monte Zeda from which you descend the North ridge reserved for expert hikers and finally to the Alpe Forna' bivouac under the north face of Zeda

r.name: M14 - Malesco - Bocchetta di Cortechiuso
r.description: From Malesco to Fondo li Gabbi in Val Loana, partially following the road and then for mule track at Alpe Scaredi gate of the Val Grande, then with easy path, in the high meadows, to the Bocchetta di Cortechiuso
Sentiero Italia - Tappa D01

r.name: P14 - Pogallo - Cima Marsicce
r.description: A magnificent panoramic path with breathtaking views of the ridges of the BOVE trail, elementary but tiring to the Alpe Busarasca, the long final crest is reserved for hikers specially experienced

r.name: Alpe Varola - Fontan Gemelle - Corte Morgin
r.description: Similar to its lower twin P06a but more tiring and hard to find because unmarked. To make a ring it is advisable to follow it on the way and return to P06a

r.name: Alpe Varola - Corte Morgin
r.description: Path for lovers of solitude in the beech woods of the Val Pobbie. Corte Morgin at the confluence of three rivers is a pleasant surprise on a sunny coast still rich in meadows.

r.name: P06 - Cicogna - Varola - Curgei - Pizzo Pernice
r.description: Tough route for steep slopes to go up, but no technical difficulty, even marks, albeit sometimes distant, are present throughout the path and the trace is always visible

r.name: R24 Gonte - Casola - Manegra
r.description: From Gonte to Manegra via Alpe Casola. Start between inhabited hamlets, then trail with some steep parts, from A.Casola forest road. From Cappella S.Maria to A.Casola poor maintenance; difficult passage in small valley ~780 m under A.Casola.

r.name: R00 Verbania Intra P.le Flaim - Trobaso - Cambiasca - Caprezzo - Intragna - Aurano
r.description: From Verbania Intra P.le Flaim through Trobaso,Cambiasca,Caprezzo,Intragna to Aurano, crossroad with R8,R14,R15. Long path that enters the uncontaminated Valle Intrasca of the San Giovanni torrent, adjoining the Val Grande National Park.

r.name: R10 Sacro Monte S.S.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino - Piancavallo - Colle - Passo Folungo
r.description: Long route from the Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa,Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage,to Passo Folungo,between Valle Intrasca and Cannobina,through Caronio,Pollino,Luera,Manegra, Piancavallo,crossroads for Cima Morissolo,Colle,Pian d'Arla and Pian Puzz.

r.name: R14 Aurano - Luera
r.description: The route starts from Aurano, crosses some little valleys to reach the Alpe Erbia and then, with a flat path, reaches Luera, crossroads the R10, R12, R18, R22 routes.

r.name: R03 Cambiasca - Pian Cavallone - Pizzo Marona - Monte Zeda
r.description: Route of great landscape interest that goes from Cambiasca to Monte Zeda passing from the peak of Pizzo Marona; it crosses Miazzina,Alpe Pala,Cappella Fina,Pian Cavallone,Colle Forcola,Passo del Diavolo,Pizzo Marona. Exposed stretch with chains.

r.name: R07 Intragna - Cappella del Pian Cavallone
r.description: In very open environment between Intragna and the Rifugio Pian Cavallone CAI Verbano,through Cambiesso and Sunfaì along the route of the Valle Intrasca Marathon.Continuing on R03,near the ruined of ex-hotel,there is the winter bivouac always open.

r.name: R05 Caprezzo - Pian Cavallone bivio R07
r.description: The route connects Caprezzo to the R07 crossroads just below the CAI refuge at Pian Cavallone. From Caprezzo, climbing to the Mon Rous and Ad Vel pastures, you reach Cappella Porta, then, in a beech and fir wood, climb to the CAI Verbano refuge.

r.name: R03a Cappella Fina bivio R03 - Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala
r.description: Connection route between Cappella Fina (crossroads R03) and crossroads with R05 Cappella Porta-Cornala. Useful for the R03-R05 ring route through Pian Cavallone. Some large part of the route on a wide dirt road and part on path. Some small stream fords.

r.name: R30 'Via delle Genti': tratto Cannero - Oggebbio - Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Verbania Intra
r.description: Historic "Via delle Genti". Route from Cannero to Intra through the numerous hamlets of Oggebbio. Superb panoramic view of Lake Maggiore in a succession of frescoed oratories and chapels. Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa, Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage.

r.name: R32 Fodrasca - Colle
r.description: Route that connects Fodrasca, crossroad with R20, to Colle, crossroad with R10, passing near the old mountain huts of fhe pastures Bellino, Scesolo and Cadelina.

r.name: R36 Fudrasca - Monte Pian Bello
r.description: From the junction with R20 to Fudrasca, towards Piazza, near the Oratory of Sant'Eurosia of the XVII century (crossroad S11), then towards Colle Pianbello (crossroad S09) to finish on Mount Pianbello to the R38. Panoramic views of Lake Maggiore.

r.name: R38 Trarego - Monte Pian Bello
r.description: From Trarego, at the crossroads with the R20, towards the Büsé and Lemanno mountain pastures; cross the SP92 Trarego - Colle and pass near to Cima Ologno to reach Monte Pianbello. Panoramic route overlooking Lake Maggiore.

r.name: R42 Viggiona - Monte Carza
r.description: From Viggiona,at the crossroad with R46,towards Piazza del Pozzo and then to Monte Carza,insertion R40. Just before the top there is the Stella del Lago Maggiore Chapel,a wonderful view of Lake Maggiore. Remains of military posts of the First World War.

r.name: R20 Cannero - Oggiogno - Trarego - Cima l'Alpe - Monte Spalavera - Pian Puzz - Archia - Passo Folungo - Monte Zeda
r.description: Route of great historical and landscape interest that goes from Cannero to Monte Zeda passing through Oggiogno, Trarego, Cima l'Alpe, Monte Spalavera slope north, Pian Puzz, Archia; from Passo Folungo to Pian Vadà along the Cadorna Road.

r.name: R19 Passo Folungo - Monte Vadà - Bivio R20 al Pian Vadà
r.description: Direct route from Passo Folungo to Pian Vadà passing from the summit of M.Vadà. The Pian Vadà refuge can be reached with a connection to the last bend of the Strada Cadorna. Path with steep sections facilitated by some chains, but only in the first part.

r.name: R30a Cannero - Cassino
r.description: From the boat dock of Cannero you pass alongside the marina and the town beach. Go along the last part of the lakefront, go up to the SS 34, cross it and enter the mule track to Cassino up to the intersection with R30.

r.name: Percorso Druogno-Re "Pineta"
r.description: Si tratta dell’itinerario ciclabile per eccellenza della Val Vigezzo in quanto presenta una pista ciclabile dedicata pressoché continua, tranne un breve tratto su strada secondaria a basso traffico prima del campo sportivo di Santa Maria Maggiore e nell’a

r.name: S03 'Via delle Genti': tratto Cannobio - Cannero Riviera
r.description: Historic "Via delle Genti", route from Cannobio to Cannero. Evocative villages and lush woods. Panorama on Lake Maggiore and the Castles of Cannero. To note the medieval village of Carmine Superiore with the church of San Gottardo (XIV century).

From Colle on an old military road with easy hairpin turns climb the southern side of the M.Spalavera. View of L.Maggiore. Under the summit the path is slightly steeper and some trenches. The descent to the NE on a grassy slope,rhododendrons,beech forest.

r.name: R40 Cheglio - Monte Carza
r.description: The route runs from R46 junction at Cheglio,one of the three villages of Trarego-Viggiona,through woods and pastures. From the Monti Lemanni, with a short ascent it leads to the meadows at altitude,meets the branches of R38a and S05 and reaches M.Carza.
Sentiero Italia - Tappa E68
Sentiero Italia - Tappa E69

r.name: M00 - Via del Mercato da Masera a Re (prima sezione)
S00 Cannobio - Finero
r.description: From Cannobio to Finero,a long route on the Via Borromea in Val Cannobina on the left bank of the valley.A walk in the chestnut groves between the localities of the valley meeting tabernacles,votive crosses and chapels linked to the passage of the saint.
Sentiero Italia - Tappa E67

r.name: R09 Intragna - Onunchio - Colle della Forcola
r.description: Intragna and pasture Corpetto, Doaglia, Usciago, Casaiuva, Onunchio, Colle della Forcola. A path in the San Giovanni Valley on practicable and signposted paths up to Onunchio, then less obvious signs with some demanding passages.

r.name: R11 Scareno - Alpe Piaggia - Passo Folungo
r.description: Scareno, Ponte del Dragone, Alpe Piaggia, Corte Bavarone, Passo Folungo. Before Corte Bavarone di Sotto pay attention to the descent on Rio Scogno where the bridge also collapsed, ford to cross the stream.

r.name: R26 Oggiogno - Alpe Morissolo
r.description: Oggiogno (crossroads with R20), Alpe Ronno (crossroads with R26a), Alpe Morissolo, crossroads with R10 on the panoramic Strada Cadorna near the Cima di Morissolo.

r.name: R28 Malpensata (Oggiogno) - Colle
r.description: Malpensata (Oggiogno) crossroads R20, Monti Faiet, Colle (Strada Cadorna) crossroads R10.

r.name: R46 Molineggi - Viggiona - Trarego
r.description: Molineggi crossroads S03, Viggiona crossroads R42, Cheglio crossroads R40, Trarego crossroads R20.

r.name: R44 Cannero - Trarego
r.description: Cannero crossroads R30, Cheglio crossroads R40, Trarego crossroads R20.

r.name: R03b Piè di Zeda - Costa Monte Zeda (bivio R03)
r.description: The route connects Piè di Zeda, from the crossroads of R20 that climbs to the summit, with the route R03 between Monte Zeda and Pizzo Marona.

r.name: R13 Scareno - Pian d'Arla
r.description: The route connects Scareno to Pian d'Arla (crossroads R10) passing through the pastures Ca Rod, La Rocca and Sassello (crossroads R13a).

r.name: R15 Aurano - Calpera - il Colle
r.description: The route connects Aurano passing through its numerous ancient Courts and Pastures (Giovanoli, Segletta connected by a short detour, Caramelli, Laveggio, Calpera) to il Colle, a crossroads of numerous other routes coming from all directions.

r.name: R15a Bivio R15 Alpe Segletta - Piancavallo
r.description: The route starts from the crossroads with the R15 at Alpe Segletta (beginning south of Corte Giovanoli), along a stretch of carriage road, a stretch of dirt road, then on a path to reach Piancavallo.

r.name: R15b Calpera - Pian d'Arla
r.description: The route starts from the crossroads with the R15 at Alpe Calpera, descends to the Rio Scarnasca and crosses it on an ancient bridge, passes near the Gesola, from Corte Sceglu, Alpe Scarnasca, to finally reach Pian d'Arla.

r.name: R11a Piaggia - Onunchio
r.description: The route starts from Alpe Piaggia at the crossroads with R11, reaches Alpe Guara, now only ruins, crosses the Rio dei Belmi, passes by Alpe Occhio and ends at the crossroads of R09 under Alpe Onunchio.

r.name: M00 - Via del Mercato da Re a Camedo (seconda sezione)
M16a - Piano di Sale - Laurenzo bivio M16
R09a Corpetto - Bivio R11 Cappella sopra Ponte del Dragone
r.description: From the mountain pasture of Corpetto near Intragna go down to the Usciago Fondo bridge over the San Giovanni stream to go up to the crossroads with R11 to the Chapel above the Ponte del Dragone in the direction of Piaggia.

r.name: R07a Cambiesso - Cappella Porta
r.description: From Cambiesso to Cappella Porta passing by Corte Steppio, still loaded with animals in summer and with some well-kept huts, and then by the old pastures of Pechi-Campale, Gajin and Fai. Numerous fords. Some passages exposed but equipped

r.name: S01 Socraggiolo - Finero
r.description: From Socraggiolo to Finero, a long path in Val Cannobina on the orographic right of the valley. A walk in beech and chesnut woods between different locations in the valley passing through Crealla, Falmenta, Gurro and Provola.

r.name: S00a Ponte Falmenta - Bivio S00 Drignago
r.description: From Provincial Road 75 of the Cannobina Valley at Ponte Falmenta, through Descelo and Slina, to the crossroads of S00 near Drignago from where you can reach Gurrone and Cavaglio.

r.name: M29b - la Colma di Craveggia - la Colla
M33 - in Bies - Bocchetta di Sant'Antonio
M35 - Zornasco - Alpe Fontana Verde
r.description: Initially very steep path once you reach the ridge follow it with easier slopes. A small stretch at altitude 1147 on a steep slope on the north side requires attention. The last stretch from altitude 1410 to Alpe Fontana Verde is suitable for tourists

r.name: M00b - Villette - Folsogno
r.description: Short route that initially runs through the streets of the historic center in Villette then crosses halfway up the hill and then downhill through a chestnut forest until it emerges after a ford in Folsogno

r.name: M37 - Villette - Bocchetta di Sant'Antonio
r.description: An interesting path between larch groves and blueberry meadows following the ancient mule track on which the wealthy lords of the belle epoque went to the thermal baths of Bagni di Craveggia

r.name: M39 - Folsogno - Bocchetta di Sant'Antonio
r.description: Interesting and pleasant trip up to La Cailina from which it is possible make return with a circular route to Alpe Blizz and then following the M37, beyond it becomes very tiring and difficult to follow and intended for expert hikers

r.name: S00b - Lunecco - Bivio S00 (vicinanze Drignago)
r.description: From Lunecco (SP 75 Val Cannobina) go up in the direction of Slina. At an altitude of about 510/520 m turn right in the direction of Cavaglio. Nearby of Drignago you cross the S00 route.

r.name: S00e Cursolo - Airetta - Ponte Teia - Gurro
r.description: From Cursolo, at the crossroads of S00, descend to Airetta on the SS631 of the Val Cannobina; go along it for 6/700 m and descend to Ponte Teia on the Cannobino torrent; from here, passing next to Sasso Durone, you go up to Gurro at the crossroads of S01.

r.name: S05 Cannobio - Monte Carza
r.description: From Cannobio (Casali Bagnara) you go up to Piatè, you pass near a little lake and the source of Acqua Minerale. Subsequently to the Masarecci huts and the Pro Redond farm to then exit on the ridge at the crossroads with R40 for Monte Carza.

r.name: S07 Sant'Anna (Traffiume) - Pro Redond
r.description: From the Orrido of S.Anna in Traffiume, after passing the SP 75, go up a steep mule track to I Pianoni, take the left and pass the Rio Barala, go up to Alpe Gallona and reach Pro Redond, a wonderful balcony overlooking the northern part of Lake Maggiore.

r.name: S09 Bivio S11 sopra Socraggio - Bocchetta del Tondone
r.description: From the crossroads of S11 above Socraggio go up to alp Piazzola and Aurasco; from here to the Monti Sommalemna (with S09a you reach the Monti Pianoni) and to the Bocchetta del Tondone.

r.name: S09a Monti Sommalemna - Monti Pianoni
r.description: From the Monti Sommalemna, at the crossroads with the S09, you reach I Pianoni passing through the mountain pastures of the Monti Nuvo, then connect with the S07.

r.name: S11 Socraggio - Piazza S.Eurosia
r.description: From Socraggio go up and pass west of Cima Tondone, you reach Alpe Graggio, Suria and then Piazza where there are the Oratory of Sant'Eurosia and a picnic area.

r.name: S11a Aurasco - Alpe Graggio
r.description: From Alpe Aurasco, at the crossroads with S09, you pass Cima Tondone around west and you reach Alpe Graggio at the crossroads with S11. From here you reach Piazza where the Oratory of Sant'Eurosia and a picnic area are located.

r.name: S13 Luera - Archia
r.description: From Luera at the crossroads with S01 go up to the huts of the mountain pastures of the Monti di Rodé, then to Cima Cerro to reach Alpe Archia at the crossroads with R20.

r.name: S15 Crealla - Passo Folungo
r.description: From Crealla, along the orographic left of the Rio Crealla, passing through Doro Sotto, Pianca, Lismaggio, Lavé, up to Passo Folungo.

r.name: S01d Ponte Spoccia - Falmenta
r.description: At Ponte Spoccia, on the Provincial Road 75 of the Valle Cannobina, go down for about 400 m until the crossroads for Solgia, pass through the hamlet of Solgia and la Valle to reach Falmenta.

r.name: S02 Cannobio - San Bartolomeo Valmara
r.description: From Cannobio to San Bartolomeo Valmara, walking first on the long lake of Lido di Cannobio and then on the "Via delle Genti" through Campeglio, Cinzago, San Bartolomeo in Montibus with its beautiful ancient church of Romanesque origin, Formine.

r.name: S02b Cannobio Lignago - Sant'Agata - Campeglio
r.description: From Cannobio to Sant'Agata, "balcony of Lake Maggiore", passing through Gerbia and I Ronchi, through woods and terraces, to the crossroads of S02 in Campeglio.

r.name: S02c Campeglio - Ronco - Formine
r.description: From Campeglio to Formine passing through Ronco. At the crossroads with S02e, route for Marchile and Rondonico, the connection for San Bartolomeo in Montibus.

r.name: S10 Cavaglio - Le Biuse - Monte Limidario
r.description: A long and demanding route that leads from Cavaglio to the panoramic peak of Monte Limidario through the wonderful mountain pasture of Monti Olzeno, Le Biuse with the Rifugio delle Nevi, Tre Confini, Catta Margugna and the bivouac of Alpe Quadra.

r.name: S12 Orasso - Bugnago - Spoccia
r.description: High route between Orasso and Spoccia through the terraces and high mountain pastures of the two villages: Bugnago, Ghilone, Niva and Cheibi (Monti Ghebbio).

r.name: S10b Spoccia bivio S12 - Catta Margugna
r.description: From Spoccia to Catta Margugna, a complex route with long sections on very exposed slopes, section on ledge with the presence of chains, steep sections difficult with holes and stones between shrubs and rhododendrons.

r.name: S06 Sant'Agata - Faierone - Monte Limidario
r.description: Demanding route from Sant'Agata to the top of the Limidario. After the pastures of Monti Marcalone, Rombiago and Scierz, the route go up entirely on a long and panoramic ridge that runs through the Monte Faierone, Punta Fonzina and the Cruit.

r.name: S04 Bivio S02 S.Bartolomeo in Montibus - Monte Faierone
r.description: From the crossroads of S02 between San Bartolomeo in Montibus and Formine, climb to the meadows of L'Agher (Prati d'Agro), a wonderful balcony on Lake Maggiore, and then climb up to the north summit of Monte Faierone via its eastern ridge.

r.name: S08 Cavaglio - Monte Giove
r.description: From Cavaglio San Donnino go along the Rio Cavaglio valley and cross it on the Ganna bridge, go up to the mountain pastures Cruscina and Biessen to reach Alpe Rombiago (Baita degli Zabò refuge) and from here to the nearby top of the Monte Giove.

r.name: S08a Monti Biessen - Bivio S06 Alpe Scesel
r.description: Halfway connection between the S08 route at Monti Biessen and the S06 route near the Alpe Scesel which go up at west of Sant'Agata.

r.name: S14 Orasso - Alpe Pluni
r.description: From Orasso to Alpe Pluni (Polunia) passing through Monte Vecchio and crossing the pass at the southwestern slopes of Monte Torriggia. Refuge in Monte Vecchio and bivouac at Alpe Pluni.

r.name: S16 Cursolo - Alpe Pluni
r.description: From Cursolo to Alpe Pluni passing through the Monti Pratini and Monti of Cursolo, then bypassing the Costa Torriggia to go up to the crossroads with the route S14 just before the Alpe Pluni bivouac.

r.name: S10c Spoccia bivio S10d (S12) - Cappella di Lego - Tre Confini
r.description: From Spoccia, from the crossroads with the S10d route (near the church also the crossroads with S12), to Tre Confini, the crossroads of S10 and S10d, passing through Alpe Marano and Cappella di Lego.

r.name: S19 Falmenta - Alpe Fornà - Piè di Zeda
r.description: From Falmenta to Alpe Fornà and Piè Zeda going up the Scalinata.Halfway traverse up to the Rio Falmenta, then steep climb in an alpine environment. At Fornà the refuge dedicated to the partisan U.Cavallasca Cucciolo and memorial of the shooting of '44.

r.name: S17 Falmenta - Cresta est Monte Vadà bivio R19
r.description: From Falmenta go down on asphalted road to the bridge over the Falmenta stream, after the path go up to the right to the Monti Barro and Ortighedo, then always on the N-E ridge of Monte Vadà and with a traverse reach the crossroads R19 on the east ridge.

r.name: S21 Gurro loc. Tresco, bivio S01 - La Piota
r.description: From Tresco above Gurro, crossroads with S01 and GTA, climb to the top of la Piota where you reach the Sentiero Bove. You pass by Vanzone, from the chapel of Fulca with the unattended bivouac and the Alpone.

r.name: S17a Monti Ortighedo - Passo Folungo
r.description: Half-coast route on the east side of Monte Vadà from the Monti Ortighedo to the crossroads of R19 just above Passo Folungo.

r.name: S04a Bivio S04 Prati d'Agro - Alpe Rescerasca CH (fino al Confine Italo-Svizzero)
r.description: Path that from the crossroads of S04 to the meadows of L'Agher (Prati d'Agro), passing by Alpe Cacciavino, Aurone and Frignago, reaches the Alpe Rescerasca in Switzerland (the data refer only to the part of the route up to the Italian-Swiss border ).

r.name: S29a - Finero - Ponte del Pilin
r.description: A shady walk through beech woods and old prairies, with the possibility of returning to Finero after the Ponte del Pilin on path S27 to Provola and then S01

r.name: R48 Cannero bivio S03 - Viggiona
r.description: Cannero crossroads S03, Viggiona, parish church, crossroads R46.

r.name: S25 - Provola di Finero - Passo delle Crocette
S10d Spoccia - Bronte - Tre Confini
r.description: From Spoccia to Tre Confini passing through Bronte di Spoccia.

r.name: S18 - Finero - Alpe Pluni - Pian di Strii - Alpe L'Alpino
r.description: Finero - Alpe Pluni - Pian di Strii - Alpe L'Alpino

r.name: S99 Bocchetta di Cortechiuso - Monte Zeda
M51- Bagni di Craveggia - Bocchetta del Ragozzo
M47 - Alpe Cortaccio - Laghetti dei Muini
M49 - Bivio M51 - Alpe di Ruggia
M45 - Bagni di Craveggia - Bocchetta della Cima
M37d Bocchetta di S. Antonio - Bocchetta della Cima
M43 - Bagni di Craveggia - Bocchetta di S. Antonio
M43b - Bivio M43 - Alpe Motto sopra
M51a - Fondo Monfracchio - Cresta di Moriming
M53 - Fondo Isorno - B.ta di Medaro
M55 - Fondo Monfracchio - Cima di Fracchia
R13a Sassello - Corte Bavarone
r.description: The route connects Sassello (crossroads R13), north of Scareno, to Corte Bavarone (crossroads R11) passing through the Ponte della Gula, Scagnal, Curt di Ferii, Cortaccio.

r.name: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 11 - Cannobio - Verbania lntra
r.description: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.

r.name: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 7 - Porto Valtravaglia - Luino - Maccagno
r.description: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.

r.name: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 7 - Variante alta Colmegna - Maccagno
r.description: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.

r.name: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 8 - Maccagno - Pino - Zenna - Vira Gambarogno (CH)
r.description: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.

r.description: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.
